statement: Question: is it possible to add edges in G such that the resulting embedding remains plane and has diameter at most d?
context: Bounded Face BDC (FPDC) Input: a plane graph G with face-degree at most k ∈ N≥3 , and d ∈ N Question: is it possible to add edges in G such that the resulting embedding remains plane and has diameter at most d? We directly have the following corollary of Theorem 2. I Theorem 7. It is possible to construct an O(n3 )+22 O((kd) log d) ·n-step algorithm for FPDC.
